title: vLLM engine image rebuilt from public sources
question: Can a user who clones this repository build the engine image without any pre-built or retained prerequisite image?
answer: Yes. docker-build-vllm.sh builds the runtime base, the compiled extension image and the overlay engine image from public inputs only.

host.gpus: 8x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (SM120)

public_inputs_only: the pinned fork source committed in this repository (vllm/ submodule)
arch_gating_evidence: Not building Machete kernels as no compatible archs found in CUDA target architectures
Not building AllSpark kernels as no compatible archs found in CUDA target architectures
Not building scaled_mm_c3x_sm90 as no compatible archs found in CUDA target architectures
Not building SM10x/11x NVFP4/MXFP4 as no compatible archs were found
Not building CUTLASS MLA as no compatible archs were found
FlashMLA will not compile: unsupported CUDA architecture 12.0
notes: The fork's Dockerfile hardcodes ARG max_jobs=2, which serializes the ~410-target CUDA compile; the script raises MAX_JOBS to the host core count.
Neither the fork nor this repository carries git tags, so the build context is a tagged synthetic export of the pinned commit and setuptools_scm resolves the wheel version from that tag.
build.vllm_commit_note: The fork main was force-updated after the build; the previously pinned 4980e06225532feca2ebad8c834dab3f7739acb9 and the current 005b0af0d996d354dde582152909be96f7feac07 share tree 803434a5702fa871123b1ec370b6e96c47d00c2e, so the compiled content is unaffected.
build.rebuild_note: All three images were rebuilt after the fork main was force-updated to 005b0af0d996d354dde582152909be96f7feac07 (identical tree). The repin rebuild took 16 minutes with MAX_JOBS=64, and the rebuilt engine image was re-validated: image checks passed, serving reached Application startup complete, 11/11 API smoke tests passed, and correctness again gave 9/10 exact and 5/5 retrieval with only the reverse failure.

image_verification.deepgemm_page32_patched: compiled _C carries the relaxed SM120 gate string '(not is_fp4 and (block_kv == 32 or block_kv == 64))'
image_verification.deepgemm_stock_backup_retained: compiled stock _C kept as _C<abi>.so.before-page32 with '(not is_fp4 and block_kv == 64)'
image_verification.flashinfer: 0.6.18.post1 with page32, masked-logits and masked-values patches verified in the source tree

serving_validation.config: TP8, DSpark K3, FULL_DECODE_ONLY CUDA graphs, 1M context, block 64, gpu-memory-utilization 0.85, linear_backend flashinfer_b12x, deep_gemm_moe_small_m_alignment 64
serving_validation.startup: Application startup complete; graph capturing finished in 6 secs on every TP rank; no illegal memory access
runtime_kernel_selection: deep_gemm not found in site-packages, trying vendored vllm.third_party.deep_gemm
DeepGEMM E8M0 enabled on current platform
serving_validation.api_smoke: 11/11 passed (plain-chat, reasoning-high, reasoning-stream, reasoning-none, tool-auto, tool-roundtrip, tool-stream, reasoning-tool, reasoning-tool-stream, tool-required, tool-named)

correctness.known_failure: reverse (expected thedwards, got thewards) - identical to the retained deployment

matched_benchmark.protocol: 168 requests, 21 scenarios, 3 repeats, medians; raw /v1/completions, 128 input / 256 output tokens; client ran inside the serving container

caveats: This is not a fresh alternating A/B: the comparison is against previously recorded medians taken on VM100 with the retained image.
The rebuild ran on a different host of the same GPU model, so small deltas cover host and timing variation as well as any artifact difference.
The SGLang engine, the VM100 deployment and the published benchmark aggregates were not re-validated here.
Upstream vllm-flash-attn builds FA3 unconditionally; those Hopper kernels are present but unusable on SM120 and cannot be disabled through a supported flag.

clean_clone_build.what: A git clone --recursive of the published repository into an empty directory, followed by MAX_JOBS=64 STEPS=all ./docker-build-vllm.sh with no warm build cache and no pre-built prerequisite image on the host.

submodules_resolved.sglang: da64c5cbb8cf6bfd39be19da43573fdfd484c43a (orphan preview commit, servable by SHA)

clean_clone_build.result: Build completed successfully; the engine image passes the same image checks, reaches Application startup complete, passes 11/11 API smoke tests, and reproduces 9/10 exact plus 5/5 retrieval with only the reverse failure.
clean_clone_build.reproducibility_note: The clean-clone build produced different image IDs than the earlier build of the same commit, with identical image sizes. The build is not bit-reproducible because apt packages and several pip dependencies are resolved at build time rather than pinned by digest. The engine content and behaviour are equivalent, but the image IDs recorded earlier in this file refer to that earlier build and are not stable across rebuilds.
